name: small-task-on-named-device-dispatches
goal: Small tasks (tier `t1`, e.g. one or two scoped files) take the `direct` path by default: the lead does them in its own local worktree and no task session opens. Today that also happens when the task names a device (`device: 'build-box'`), ignoring the device. When a task's path would be `direct` and it names a device other than `local`, dispatch it instead so its task session opens on that device.
